in_marathi.name: Karamveer
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Duty or duty bound hero
in_marathi.long_meaning: Karamveer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Karamveer is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Karma’ and ‘Veer’. ‘Karma’ stands for action or duty, while ‘Veer’ means hero. So, Karamveer is a name that signifies a hero who performs his duty courageously and selflessly. In Hindu mythology, the god Krishna is often referred to as Karamveer, as he fulfilled his duty towards his people and the universe.
